purpose: Analyze football teams and matchup reality before bookmaker-market mapping.

analysis_requirements.player_matchups: Compare individual player capability against direct or tactical opponent matchup; names/reputation alone are insufficient.
analysis_requirements.team_cohesion: Measure collective coordination separately from individual quality.
analysis_requirements.player_quality_and_cohesion: Represent teams that combine elite individual quality with collective performance.
analysis_requirements.transfer_impact: Account for incoming and outgoing player impact, minutes replaced, role importance, adaptation and squad continuity upstream before normalization.
analysis_requirements.attack_vs_defence: Compare each attack against the opposing defence and vice versa.
analysis_requirements.temporal_scoring_defending: Model when teams score/concede and whether they retain or lose leads.
analysis_requirements.league_and_club_strength: Support cross-league comparisons without treating club size or league reputation as automatic outcomes.
analysis_requirements.shot_and_chance_quality: Use shots, shots on target, chance quality and defensive shot vulnerability; raw shot count alone is insufficient.
analysis_requirements.position_home_away_environment: Include league position, home/away splits, venue/environment and psychology/context evidence.
analysis_requirements.head_to_head: H2H must be relevance-weighted by recency, manager continuity, squad continuity and tactical continuity.
analysis_requirements.match_statistics_patterns: Permit evidence-backed patterns such as late concessions, poor lead retention, high-quality chance creation or press vulnerability.

correlation_policy.rule: Each correlation family may contribute at most once to the composite/calibrated model even when visible in several explanatory domains.
correlation_policy.example: xG, shots on target, big chances and attack-vs-defence evidence may share a chance-creation correlation family.
correlation_policy.goal: Prevent artificial confidence through double counting.
